Putting the values, we get:
[latex]\begin{aligned} x_1&=\left [ 1-\frac{e-1}{e} \right ]=\left [ \frac{e-e+1}{e} \right ]=e^{-1}\\ \text{Also, }x_2&=\left [ x_1-\frac{f(x_1)}{f'(x_1)} \right ]\;\;...(ii)\\ \text{Now, }x_1&=\frac{1}{e}=e^{-1} \text{ and } f(x_1)=(e^{e^{-1}}-1)\\ f'(x_1)&=e^{e^{-1}} \end{aligned}[/latex]

explanation_text: Given [latex]A=\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1\\ -1&-1 \end{bmatrix}, [/latex] [latex]B=\begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix}, [/latex][latex]C=\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} [/latex] Transfer function of the given system is given by [latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=C(sI-A)^{-1}B [/latex] Now, [latex] (sI-A)=\begin{bmatrix} s & 0\\ 0 & s \end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1\\ -1&-1 \end{bmatrix} [/latex] [latex]\;\;\;=\begin{bmatrix} s & -1\\ 1&s+1 \end{bmatrix} [/latex] [latex](sI-A)^{-1}=\frac{1}{|sI-A|}(Adj[A]) [/latex] [latex]|sI-A|=s(s+1)+1=(s^2+s+1) [/latex] and [latex] Adj[A]=\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix} [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\;(sI-A)^{-1}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix} [/latex] [latex]\therefore[/latex] Transfer function, [latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\left \{ \begin{bmatrix} 1 &0 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix} \right \} [/latex] [latex]\;\;=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\left \{ \begin{bmatrix} (s+1) & 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix}\right \}[/latex] [latex] \;\;=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} \times 1 [/latex] [latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} [/latex] Given, input=unit step [latex] \therefore \;\;  U(s)=\frac{1}{s} [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\; Y(s)=\frac{1}{s}\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}=\frac{1}{s(s^2+s+1)} [/latex] [latex]\therefore[/latex] Final Value [latex]\lim_{s\rightarrow 0}[sY(s)][/latex] [latex]=\lim_{s\rightarrow 0}\left [ \frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} \right ]=1 [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\;[/latex] Error=Final value -Initial value [latex]e_{ss}=0[/latex]
explanation_html:
Given [latex]A=\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1\\ -1&-1 \end{bmatrix}, [/latex] [latex]B=\begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix}, [/latex][latex]C=\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} [/latex]
Transfer function of the given system is given by
[latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=C(sI-A)^{-1}B [/latex]
Now, [latex] (sI-A)=\begin{bmatrix} s & 0\\ 0 & s \end{bmatrix}-\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1\\ -1&-1 \end{bmatrix} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;\;=\begin{bmatrix} s & -1\\ 1&s+1 \end{bmatrix} [/latex]
[latex](sI-A)^{-1}=\frac{1}{|sI-A|}(Adj[A]) [/latex]
[latex]|sI-A|=s(s+1)+1=(s^2+s+1) [/latex]
and [latex] Adj[A]=\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\;(sI-A)^{-1}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore[/latex] Transfer function,
[latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\left \{ \begin{bmatrix} 1 &0 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} s+1 & 1\\ -1&s \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix} \right \} [/latex]
[latex]\;\;=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}\left \{ \begin{bmatrix} (s+1) & 1 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 0\\ 1 \end{bmatrix}\right \}[/latex]
[latex] \;\;=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} \times 1 [/latex]
[latex]\frac{Y(s)}{U(s)}=\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} [/latex]
Given, input=unit step
[latex] \therefore \;\; U(s)=\frac{1}{s} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\; Y(s)=\frac{1}{s}\frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)}=\frac{1}{s(s^2+s+1)} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore[/latex] Final Value
[latex]\lim_{s\rightarrow 0}[sY(s)][/latex]
[latex]=\lim_{s\rightarrow 0}\left [ \frac{1}{(s^2+s+1)} \right ]=1 [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\;[/latex] Error=Final value -Initial value
[latex]e_{ss}=0[/latex]

explanation_text: From the given Bode plot, it is clear that corner frequencies, [latex]\omega _{c1}=\frac{1}{3}[/latex] and [latex]\omega _{c2}=1[/latex] [latex] \therefore[/latex]  Transfer function of given system is given by [latex]T(s)=\frac{C(s)}{R(s)}=\left [ \frac{1+3s}{1+s} \right ]=\left [ \frac{1+Ts}{1+\alpha Ts} \right ] [/latex] Here, [latex]T=3[/latex] and  [latex]\alpha T=1,[/latex] [latex] \alpha =\frac{1}{3}[/latex] As  [latex] \alpha \lt 1[/latex], therefore the transfer function T(s) represents a lead compensator having [latex]\alpha =\frac{1}{3}[/latex] [latex] \therefore[/latex]   Maximum phase shift, [latex]\phi _{m}=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1-\alpha }{2\sqrt{\alpha }} \right ][/latex] [latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1-\frac{1}{3}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}} \right ][/latex] [latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{2}{3}\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \right ][/latex] [latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right ]=30^{\circ} [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\; \phi _m=30^{\circ}[/latex] Also, [latex]T(j\omega )=\frac{1+j3\omega }{1+j\omega } [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\;  |T(j\omega )|=\frac{\sqrt{1+9\omega ^2}}{\sqrt{1+\omega ^2}} [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\; Gain G_m[/latex] in dB [latex]=20log |T(j\omega )| [/latex] [latex]=20 log_{10}\left [ \frac{\sqrt{1+9\omega ^2_m}}{1+\omega ^2_m} \right ][/latex] Now, [latex] \omega _m=\frac{1}{T\sqrt{\alpha }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} [/latex] [latex]\therefore \;\; G_m=20 log_{10}\left [ \sqrt{\frac{1+9\times \left ( \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right )^2}{1+\left ( \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right )^2}} \right ][/latex] [latex]=20 log_{10}\left [ \sqrt{\frac{1+3}{1+\frac{1}{3}}} \right ]=20 log_{10}\sqrt{3} [/latex] [latex]G_m=4.77dB[/latex]
explanation_html:
From the given Bode plot, it is clear that corner frequencies,
[latex]\omega _{c1}=\frac{1}{3}[/latex] and [latex]\omega _{c2}=1[/latex]
[latex] \therefore[/latex] Transfer function of given system is given by
[latex]T(s)=\frac{C(s)}{R(s)}=\left [ \frac{1+3s}{1+s} \right ]=\left [ \frac{1+Ts}{1+\alpha Ts} \right ] [/latex]
Here, [latex]T=3[/latex] and [latex]\alpha T=1,[/latex]
[latex] \alpha =\frac{1}{3}[/latex]
As [latex] \alpha \lt 1[/latex], therefore the transfer function T(s) represents a lead compensator having [latex]\alpha =\frac{1}{3}[/latex]
[latex] \therefore[/latex] Maximum phase shift,
[latex]\phi _{m}=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1-\alpha }{2\sqrt{\alpha }} \right ][/latex]
[latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1-\frac{1}{3}}{\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}} \right ][/latex]
[latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{2}{3}\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \right ][/latex]
[latex]=tan^{-1}\left [ \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right ]=30^{\circ} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\; \phi _m=30^{\circ}[/latex]
Also,
[latex]T(j\omega )=\frac{1+j3\omega }{1+j\omega } [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\; |T(j\omega )|=\frac{\sqrt{1+9\omega ^2}}{\sqrt{1+\omega ^2}} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\; Gain G_m[/latex] in dB [latex]=20log |T(j\omega )| [/latex]
[latex]=20 log_{10}\left [ \frac{\sqrt{1+9\omega ^2_m}}{1+\omega ^2_m} \right ][/latex]
Now, [latex] \omega _m=\frac{1}{T\sqrt{\alpha }}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} [/latex]
[latex]\therefore \;\; G_m=20 log_{10}\left [ \sqrt{\frac{1+9\times \left ( \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right )^2}{1+\left ( \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}} \right )^2}} \right ][/latex]
[latex]=20 log_{10}\left [ \sqrt{\frac{1+3}{1+\frac{1}{3}}} \right ]=20 log_{10}\sqrt{3} [/latex]
[latex]G_m=4.77dB[/latex]

explanation_text: At t=2.5 ms the circuit is as shown below [latex]\begin{aligned} -V_s+V_L&=0\\ V_S&=L\frac{di}{dt}\\ \frac{V_S}{L}dt&=di \end{aligned}[/latex] Integrating on both sides [latex]\begin{aligned} \int \frac{V_m \sin \omega t d(\omega t)}{\omega L}&=\int di\\ i(t)&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L}[-\cos (\omega t)]+K \end{aligned}[/latex] when t=0.0025 sec, at this instant i(t)=0 [latex]\begin{aligned} 0&=\frac{100}{100 \pi \times 31.83 \times 10^{-3}}\\ &[-\cos (100 \pi \times 0.0025)]+K\\ &=-7.07+K\\ K&=7.07 \end{aligned}[/latex] The peak value of the inductor current will be at [latex](\omega t=\pi^c)[/latex] [latex]\begin{aligned} i(t)_{max}&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L}[-\cos (\pi)]+K\\ I_{max}&=\frac{100}{100 \pi \times 31.83 \times 10^{-3}}+7.07\\ I_{max}&=17.07 \end{aligned}[/latex]
explanation_html:
At t=2.5 ms the circuit is as shown below

[latex]\begin{aligned} -V_s+V_L&=0\\ V_S&=L\frac{di}{dt}\\ \frac{V_S}{L}dt&=di \end{aligned}[/latex]
Integrating on both sides
[latex]\begin{aligned} \int \frac{V_m \sin \omega t d(\omega t)}{\omega L}&=\int di\\ i(t)&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L}[-\cos (\omega t)]+K \end{aligned}[/latex]
when t=0.0025 sec, at this instant i(t)=0
[latex]\begin{aligned} 0&=\frac{100}{100 \pi \times 31.83 \times 10^{-3}}\\ &[-\cos (100 \pi \times 0.0025)]+K\\ &=-7.07+K\\ K&=7.07 \end{aligned}[/latex]
The peak value of the inductor current will be at [latex](\omega t=\pi^c)[/latex]
[latex]\begin{aligned} i(t)_{max}&=\frac{V_m}{\omega L}[-\cos (\pi)]+K\\ I_{max}&=\frac{100}{100 \pi \times 31.83 \times 10^{-3}}+7.07\\ I_{max}&=17.07 \end{aligned}[/latex]
